title: Only Optimization
description: Lightweight Minecraft modpack focused on FPS and perfomance.
body:
Only Optimization is a lightweight and high-performance Minecraft modpack designed to maximize FPS and ensure smooth gameplay. With a focus on optimization and minimalism, this modpack is perfect for players with low-end PCs or anyone who wants a clean, lag-free experience. Every mod included has been carefully selected to enhance performance without compromising the core Minecraft experience.

Features:
🔹 Optimized for maximum FPS and smooth performance
🔹 Lightweight and minimal, no unnecessary mods
🔹 Clean and intuitive interface
🔹 Compatible with the latest Minecraft versions
🔹 Carefully selected mods to improve gameplay and stability

Whether you want to explore, build, or adventure, Only Optimization ensures your game runs fast and stable, making Minecraft enjoyable for everyone.
